method.method_draft: Partition the image into fragments. Count the left fused aromatic ring as 6 C-C bonds. Count the additional nonshared bonds of the fused saturated/cyclohexanone ring as 5 more, then count the carbonyl C=O as 1. Count the bottom sulfate substituent as the C-O bond, O-S bond, and two S=O bonds, while excluding the H-containing bond. Count the :NH2NHPh component as N-N, N-Ph, and the six phenyl C-C bonds. Add these fragment subtotals to obtain the total number of non-hydrogen bonds.

再推理计数：按指定分块方法计数。左侧稠合芳香环计 6 个 C-C 键。稠合的饱和/环己酮环中不与芳香环共享的额外键计 5 个。羰基 C=O 计 1 个。底部 OSO2H 取代基按 C-O、O-S、两个 S=O 计 4 个，排除含氢键。右侧 :NH2NHPh 组分按 N-N、N-Ph、苯基环内 6 个 C-C 键计 8 个。总数为 6 + 5 + 1 + 4 + 8 = 24。
